# Porch & Party — Full LLM Context

Porch & Party is a Memphis-based porch decorating and celebration styling company offering seasonal front porch decorating, hotel-room decor, party decor, and grazing table setups in the Memphis metro area.

Core services: seasonal porch decorating, hotel-room decor, party decor, celebration setups, romantic room setups, birthday decorations, grazing table setups, and styled event presentation.

Porch service: seasonal porch decorating and front-entry styling for fall, Halloween, Christmas, spring, and special seasonal moments.

Celebration service: hotel decor, home party decor, birthday setups, romantic room decorations, anniversary setups, proposal setups, baby shower styling, bridal shower styling, and private celebration setups.

Grazing/event service: grazing table setups and styled event presentation for showers, corporate gatherings, retreats, private events, and hosting moments.

Service area: Memphis, Germantown, Collierville, Bartlett, Lakeland, Arlington, Southaven, Olive Branch, and nearby Memphis metro areas when the setup fits the scope.

Pricing: seasonal porch decorating starts at $350+. Celebration setups and hotel-room decor start at $300+. Grazing-table styling starts at $250+ for styling only. Food is not included by default. Final quotes depend on scope, date, city, materials, setup complexity, venue access, guest count, and optional take-down.

## Party game rentals
Porch & Party rents giant yard games, delivered and set up, for backyard parties, birthdays, reunions, church and school events, indoors or outdoors. Page: https://porchandparty901.com/rentals/

Day rates (weekend Friday-Monday = 1.5x day rate):
- Giant Connect Four (4 ft tall, indoor or outdoor): $45/day
- Cornhole set, 2 regulation boards + 8 bags (two sets available): $40/day
- Giant Tumble Tower, 54 blocks, stacks to 5 ft: $40/day
- Giant Yard Pong, 12 buckets (outdoor only): $35/day
- Ladder Toss, 2 ladders + 6 bolas: $30/day
- Giant Dice (Yardzee): $25/day
- Giant Checkers, 4x4 ft mat: $25/day
- Giant Tic-Tac-Toe, 3 ft frame: $25/day
- Giant Color Stack, 2 ft color-sorting stacking puzzle, ages 6+ (two available): $25/day

Bundles: Pick 3 $99, Pick 5 $149, Whole Yard (all 9) $225 per day or $335 for a weekend.
Delivery only, no customer pickup. We deliver in Memphis, Olive Branch and Southaven only: Zone 1 Memphis city limits (ZIP 38103-38141) $25, free on orders $150+; Zone 2 Olive Branch and Southaven, MS $40.
Terms: 24-hour rental, delivered by noon, picked up next day; 50% holds the date, balance at delivery; full refund if cancelled 48 hours out; rain or storms reschedule free within 30 days; renter 18+.
Book: https://porchandparty901.com/contact or call/text 901-355-1518.
